kit: M3-2 Final Assembly Hardware Pick Pack
basis: bom/data.json v2.11.0 generated 2026-10-12 (lead-screw Z CAD update, 6 mm frame spacers, Y idlers)
AGENTS.md design decisions: no leveling feet, no mechanical endstops

pick_list.notes: Current CAD/hardware CSV calls these inline splice plates, but README describes one connector plate per detected C-beam joint. Verify plate geometry against final corner and splice locations.

pick_list.source_basis: 135 C-beam joint screws + 4 NEMA23 face screws (X motor) + 4 idler bracket screws (2 Y idlers)
pick_list.notes: Use stainless or zinc-plated alloy steel after corrosion/strength decision. Button-head is preferred where carriage clearance matters.

pick_list.source_basis: CAD/BOM_README.md M5 fastener totals: 8 Z-post bottom plate + 2 shim + 16 Z motor (motor-mount nut traps) + 4 Y motor (2 per motor)
pick_list.notes: Z motors: through the motor flange and the printed mount's 8 mm top plate into M5 nuts in its nut traps. Y motors: turned 45 deg and bolted straight to the C-beam face slots, no plate, so 2 of the 4 flange holes land on slot centrelines; 2 bolts per motor through the flange into drop-in T-nuts (verify the length without the plate). Also used on the Z-post bottom plates and through C-beam web locations.

pick_list.source_basis: CAD/BOM_README.md M5 fastener totals: 2 per Z bottom bearing holder + 2 per Z nut block
pick_list.notes: Z bottom bearing holder (bom/data.json id 91): into drop-in T-nuts in the C-beam channel-floor slots, heads in the holder's counterbores. Z nut block (id 87): bolted in reverse through the carriage plate's holes into the block (fit tested on SN 001), with a nut inside the C-beam opening if needed.

pick_list.source_basis: CAD/BOM_README.md M5 fastener totals: 2 Y idler axles
pick_list.notes: Smooth idler axle hardware (2 Y return idlers, bom/data.json id 93).
Verify length with final gantry plate thickness and wheel stack before bulk purchase.

pick_list.source_basis: CAD/BOM_README.md M5 fastener totals (135 joint + 4 idler bracket + 8 Z-post bottom plate + 2 shim + 8 Z bottom holder + 4 Y motor); covered by bom/data.json id 6
pick_list.notes: Pack quantity intentionally keeps assembly spares and field-service margin.
Used on V-wheel and idler stacks.

pick_list.source_basis: 32 V-wheel axle nuts + 2 idler axle nuts
pick_list.notes: Do not replace with plain nuts unless threadlocker or other locking method is specified.

pick_list.source_basis: CAD/BOM_README.md M5 fastener totals: 16 Z motor-mount nut traps + 8 Z nut-block bolts (if needed) = 24; plus 4 X-motor back-side nuts per the AGENTS.md NEMA23 pass-through mounting clarification (the X-motor mount is not modeled yet)
pick_list.notes: AGENTS.md states the NEMA23 motor holes are pass-through and need back-side nuts. CAD/bom_generate.py derives 24 of the 28; the other 4 are the X motor. The Y-motor bolts go into drop-in T-nuts, not nuts. Verify on the final motor/mount stacks.

pick_list.item: M5 split lock washer or wedge-lock washer
pick_list.notes: Optional vibration-control reserve. Use only where it does not disturb wheel preload or plate flatness.

pick_list.spec: 6 mm tall, 10 mm OD, 6 mm bore/off-center
pick_list.notes: bom/data.json currently uses eccentric spacers on all 32 wheel positions for maximum preload adjustability. CAD/BOM_README.md still references 16, so verify against physical assembly.

pick_list.spec: 6 mm tall, about 10 mm OD, M5 clearance bore
pick_list.notes: Outboard wheel spacer between V-wheel and washer/locknut per current bom/data.json wheel stack.
Often included with wheel kits. Keep as an inspection checklist item until supplier wheel kits are frozen.

pick_list.source_basis: AGENTS.md NEMA23 motor mount fastening note
pick_list.notes: Use on motor mount nuts and selected vibration-prone fasteners. Do not use where future wheel preload service requires dry adjustment.

pick_list.spec: TBD clamp, pin-joint, or printed belt anchor hardware
pick_list.source_basis: CAD/BOM_README.md explicitly excludes belt clamps pending inline pin-joint design
pick_list.notes: This is the main remaining mechanical hardware unknown for a shippable final kit. Freeze after belt path and printed clamp geometry are physically verified.
Control box and electronics mounting quantities depend on enclosure/panel layout. Keep as a reserve pack until the electrical panel design is frozen.
Only needed where final 3D-printed parts use inserts. Current NEMA23 mount clarification says pass-through holes do not need heat-set inserts.

audit_flags: BOM v2.9.0 (2026-10-12): the Y axis uses 2 smooth idlers (BOM id 93), one per Y axis at the front; count smooth idler axle hardware for those 2 only.
Physically verify whether all 32 V-wheel positions need eccentric spacers or whether 16 eccentric plus 16 plain is sufficient.
Freeze belt termination hardware; current CAD hardware notes intentionally exclude belt clamps.

NEMA23 back-side nut conflict between AGENTS.md and CAD/bom_hardware.csv: the generator matched the printed Y-motor plate (id 75) by a stale 4 x 80 x 107 mm signature, so it counted zero plates (fixed 2026-10-12). The 28 nuts = 16 Z motor mount + 8 Z nut block (if needed) + 4 X; the Y motors use T-nuts, and the X-motor mount is not modeled yet.

Y-motor fastening (owner, 2026-10-12): each Y motor is turned 45 deg and bolted straight to the C-beam face slots, with no plate. Only 2 of its 4 flange holes land on slot centrelines, so it takes 2 M5 bolts + 2 drop-in T-nuts (4 of each in total) and nothing else. The printed id 75 plate is not needed; bom/data.json and the CAD still carry it (qty 2) until the follow-up removes it, so do not print it. Verify the M5 x 16 length without the plate.
Confirm connector plate geometry for each of the 27 C-beam joints before buying all plates in one style.
Do not include leveling feet in the reference kit unless the design decision is reopened.

Z hardware re-derived for the lead-screw CAD (BOM v2.11.0, 2026-10-12) by CAD/bom_generate.py: the belt-Z bottom idlers and the top-plate screws/T-nuts are gone; Z motor screws are M5 x 16 into the motor mount's nut traps; each Z nut block adds 2 M5 x 20 bolted in reverse through the carriage plate (plus a nut inside the C-beam opening if needed); each Z bottom holder adds 2 M5 x 20 + 2 drop-in T-nuts. Couplers and lock collars use their own set screws, the 608ZZ is a press fit, and the motor-mount tab is clamped by the existing post-to-top-rail joint screws. With 2 Y idlers the idler axle hardware is 2 M5 x 30, 2 nyloc, 4 washers and 4 bracket screws/T-nuts.
Verify that drop-in T-nuts fit the C-beam channel-floor slots used by the Z bottom holders.
